title: <session-dir>/cli-main.jsonl.precompact (single-copy backup)
notes: Single copy, OVERWRITTEN on every /compact. The only manual rollback channel.
Byte format is identical to cli-main.jsonl (JSONL of SessionEvent).
Not written unless a compaction actually happens (needs >=9 complete turns).

compaction.result: turn-1 = summary round (user_message '【上下文压缩】<summary<=20000 chars>' + assistant_message '上下文已压缩，以上为历史摘要。' + turn_end completed); turn-2..turn-(K+1) = the last K complete turns verbatim with only turn_start/turn_end ids renumbered
compaction.dropped: the unclosed tail turn and any events before the first turn_start
compaction.writeGuarantee: backup -> tmp + sync_all -> rename (fsync'd, unlike the other data files); failure deletes the tmp
